name: ZX_REP_AUDIT_DISTS
description: This table contains the audit references for transaction tax reporting, including the references for transactions reported in prior tax reporting periods.

columns.name: REP_TRX_TAX_DIST_ID
columns.description: Line identifier for each inserted row.

columns.name: AUDIT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: Indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Internal organization identifier of transaction.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application identifier of transaction.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier of transaction.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier of transaction.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: Event class mapping identifier of distribution.

columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: Transaction identifier from subledger.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Transaction line identifier from subledger.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code for the  transaction.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Event class code of transaction.

columns.name: TRX_LEVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Level at which transaction line identifier is stored. Possible values are LINE, SHIPMENT and FREIGHT.

columns.name: TAX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Tax line identifier of transaction.

columns.name: TAX_DIST_ID
columns.description: Recoverable or nonrecoverable tax distribution identifier for procure to pay transactions, or transaction tax distribution identifier for manual order to cash transactions.

columns.name: TRX_DATE
columns.description: Transaction date entered in subledger.

columns.name: TAX_POINT_BASIS
columns.description: Tax point basis information for transaction tax line.

columns.name: REPORTABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether tax line is reportable.

columns.name: LINES_DET_FACTOR_ID
columns.description: Line identification for tax determining factor.

columns.name: TAX_EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Event class code for transaction tax line.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code of distribution.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: HQ_ESTB_REG_NUMBER
columns.description: First party HQ establishment tax registration number.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_DIST_ID
columns.description: Transaction line distribution identifier, such as item distribution identifier, for tax distribution.

columns.name: CONTENT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for configuration owner of tax.

columns.name: TRX_TAX_DIST_ID
columns.description: Distribution identifier in transaction table for tax line or tax distribution.

columns.name: ACTG_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Categorization of accounting events that is unique within an application and event class.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Date from Oracle Fusion General Ledger that is used to determine accounting period for transactions.

columns.name: TAX_POINT_DATE
columns.description: Date on which taxpayer becomes liable for paying tax to tax authority, such as delivery date, pickup date, or invoice date.

columns.name: REPORTING_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Selection process batch identifier.

columns.name: LEGAL_REPORTING_STATUS
columns.description: Legal reporting status for tax distribution.

columns.name: AR_RECEIPT_METHOD_ID
columns.description: Receipt method identifier of transaction.

columns.name: IBY_PAYMENT_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Payment profile identifier of transaction.

columns.name: RECEIPT_CLASS_ID
columns.description: Receipt class identifier of transaction.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TRX_ID
columns.description: Payment identifier when payment is made at transaction level.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Payment identifier when payment is made at transaction line level.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TRX_DIST_ID
columns.description: Payment identifier when payment is made at transaction distribution level.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TRX_TAX_DIST_ID
columns.description: Payment identifier when payment is made at tax distribution level.

columns.name: LINE_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Line class code identifier of transaction.

columns.name: AUDIT_JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: AUDIT_JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
